attempts_adjustment_has_reason.name: attempts_adjustment_has_reason
attempts_adjustment_has_reason.value: ("attempts"."kind" = 'adjustment') = ("attempts"."actor" is not null and "attempts"."note" is not null)

jobs_placement_has_product_and_account.name: jobs_placement_has_product_and_account
jobs_placement_has_product_and_account.value: "jobs"."kind" <> 'placement' or ("jobs"."product_id" is not null and "jobs"."account_email" is not null)

products_source_submitter.name: products_source_submitter
products_source_submitter.value: ("products"."source" = 'seeded' and "products"."submitted_by_email" is null) or ("products"."source" = 'paid' and "products"."submitted_by_email" is not null)
